en_title: 'The Train Isn't Stopping' — Diablo 4 Director Promises the Game Will Still Receive Support Well After Diablo 5 Launches
cn_title: 《暗黑破坏神4》总监：续作发售后仍会支持本作
subtitle: 列车不会停下
opus_summary: 《暗黑破坏神4》总监Brent Gibson表示，《暗黑破坏神5》发售后，团队仍会继续支持前作；只要玩家持续参与，赛季内容就会继续推出。本作还将在2027年上半年加入亚马逊职业。

paragraphs.en: Diablo 4 director Brent Gibson is telling fans not to worry about the game after Diablo 5’s announcement sparked concerns about the former title’s lifespan.
paragraphs.cn: 《暗黑破坏神5》公布后，粉丝开始担心《暗黑破坏神4》还能运营多久。《暗黑破坏神4》总监Brent Gibson表示，大家不必担心。

paragraphs.en: Diablo 5’s reveal at Blizzcon 2026 left fans equal parts excited and worried. Of course, players were pumped for a new Diablo game — but with Diablo 4 having just launched in 2023, the reveal of a new game so soon felt like a death knell for the one they were still playing.
paragraphs.cn: 《暗黑破坏神5》在2026年暴雪嘉年华亮相，让粉丝既兴奋又担忧。玩家当然期待《暗黑破坏神》新作，但《暗黑破坏神4》才于2023年推出，这么快就公布续作，让仍在玩前作的玩家觉得它似乎快要走到尽头了。

paragraphs.en: But Brent Gibson, director of Diablo 4, says there’s nothing to fuss about. Speaking with Icy Veins , Gibson outlined some plans for the game’s future content, saying it will continue to receive support well after 5’s release.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《暗黑破坏神4》总监Brent Gibson表示，无须为此担心。他接受Icy Veins采访时谈到了游戏未来的内容计划，并表示即使《暗黑破坏神5》发售，团队仍会继续支持《暗黑破坏神4》。

paragraphs.en: “I have an analogy,” he began. “If you’re wearing a sign in the middle of Times Square saying, ‘The end is nigh,’ the end is not nigh. We have a lot coming. We have [the] Amazon [class] coming down the road. The train isn’t stopping.
paragraphs.cn: 他先打了个比方：「如果你站在时代广场中央，举着‘末日将至’的牌子，那末日其实并没有来。我们还有很多内容要推出，亚马逊职业也会在之后加入。这列车不会停下。」

paragraphs.en: “One of the things I love about our world is we are not a series of games. We are a universe. We are even adding to Diablo 2 with the Warlock. It’s one of the few franchises where we have the luxury of continued play, and we know our communities.
paragraphs.cn: 「我喜欢这个世界的一点是，我们做的不只是一个游戏系列，而是一个完整的宇宙。我们甚至还在为《暗黑破坏神2》加入术士职业。很少有游戏系列能像我们这样，让玩家持续玩下去；我们也了解自己的玩家群体。」

paragraphs.en: “If you’re worried, don’t sweat it, because we’re going to be making content for a long time. But we are excited about Diablo 5. We’ve got a show coming. Gone are the years of waiting a decade for more content. It’s a great place to be.”
paragraphs.cn: 「如果你担心，那就放宽心，因为我们还会在很长一段时间里继续制作内容。不过，我们也对《暗黑破坏神5》感到兴奋。我们还有一部剧集要推出。不必再等上十年才能看到更多内容了。现在的情况很令人振奋。」

paragraphs.en: More specifically, Gibson said Blizzard is planning on supporting seasons for Diablo 4 “as long as the community continues to show up” for it, specifically mentioning the ongoing support for Diablo 2 and Diablo 3.
paragraphs.cn: 具体来说，Gibson表示，只要玩家还愿意参与，暴雪就计划继续为《暗黑破坏神4》推出赛季内容。他还特别提到，暴雪至今仍在支持《暗黑破坏神2》和《暗黑破坏神3》。

paragraphs.en: “There are still people who play those games, and as long as you’re showing up, we’re going to continue to be making content," he assured.
paragraphs.cn: 他表示：「现在仍有人在玩那些游戏。只要你们还来玩，我们就会继续制作内容。」

paragraphs.en: As Gibson mentioned, Diablo 4 is getting the Amazon class in the first half of 2027. With three more years to go until Diablo 5 is released, there’s still plenty of time for developers to flesh out the title with even more classes and experiences — something they spoke about during a dedicated Diablo panel at Blizzcon this year.
paragraphs.cn: 正如Gibson所说，《暗黑破坏神4》将在2027年上半年加入亚马逊职业。距离《暗黑破坏神5》发售还有三年，开发团队仍有充足时间为前作加入更多职业和玩法。今年的暴雪嘉年华上，他们也在《暗黑破坏神》专题座谈中谈到了这件事。

paragraphs.en: “Diablo 4 has bright support,” Diablo 5 director Joe Shely said . “It's fully supported by the team. We were just announcing earlier today, coming to Diablo 4, the Amazon, the Season of Hell's legacy, Diablo 4 is coming to Switch 2, and there will continue to be ongoing support for Diablo 4. There's many reasons for players to keep playing.”
paragraphs.cn: 《暗黑破坏神5》总监Joe Shely表示：「《暗黑破坏神4》的后续支持前景很好，团队会全力支持这款游戏。就在今天早些时候，我们宣布亚马逊职业和‘地狱遗产赛季’将加入《暗黑破坏神4》，游戏也将登陆Switch 2。我们还会继续支持《暗黑破坏神4》，玩家有很多理由继续玩下去。」

paragraphs.en: “We have dedicated teams for each of those games because those games are important to us and they're really important for our community,” production director Tiffany Wat added. “I think it really gives us a really great opportunity to be able to collaborate together, to talk with one another. Even though we might be distinct teams, we still work together quite closely because ultimately we are making games for the Diablo community. I think it's the best time to be a Diablo fan.”
paragraphs.cn: 制作总监Tiffany Wat补充道：「每款游戏都有专门的团队负责，因为它们对我们和玩家社群都非常重要。我认为，这让我们有很好的机会相互交流、共同协作。虽然我们分属不同团队，但合作依然十分紧密，因为说到底，我们都是在为《暗黑破坏神》的玩家制作游戏。我觉得现在是成为《暗黑破坏神》粉丝的最好时候。」

paragraphs.en: For more Diablo news, you can check out our interview with the developers here, as well as catch up with their reaction to the series' animated show coming to Netflix .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多《暗黑破坏神》消息，可以阅读我们对开发者的采访，也可以看看他们对该系列动画剧集即将登陆Netflix有何反应。
